tools.name: get_business_info

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: The electrical services Kay1 Electric offers (panel upgrades, EV chargers, commercial work, repairs, rewiring, lighting, heat pump / hot tub wiring, smart home, inspections), each with its page URL.

tools.name: list_service_areas
tools.description: Cities in Greater Vancouver that Kay1 Electric serves, with example neighbourhoods and each city page URL.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Returns the Markdown version of a kay1electric.ca page, e.g. "/our-services/ev-charger-installation/" or "/fa/contact-us/". Use list_services, list_service_areas or https://kay1electric.ca/llms.txt to find paths.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_services, list_service_areas · Private data: get_business_info, get_page · Public sink: request_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_services, list_service_areas · Private data: get_business_info, get_page · Public sink: request_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
